vertical: cross (permits-2: state air-permit search over 20 plants; evidence rows for v-shipbuilding-naval p-corn-island-grandview-in, v-poles-substation p-nucor-crawfordsville-in and p-valmont-plymouth-in, v-mining-heavy-equipment p-construction-attachments-lenoir-nc)
decision_rule: Corrected = the value must change before it ships: it adds a fact the cited document does not show, places the fact at the wrong site, misdates it, names the wrong speaker or document, tags a judgement as stated, or the quote is not in the document (pdftotext of a fresh download, layout and raw modes, whitespace normalised, each '...' fragment checked by script). A clause on the same document but outside the quote is confirmed with a note. A permit is read as stating welding at the address as of its date, not the process or material unless named. Unreachable only if the source cannot be reached at all.
error_rate_note: Denominator: the 15 evidence rows in the inbox file (all stated). 15/15 quotes found by script on fresh downloads. The 4 plants updates are not written as rows (mirrors; see field_drift_notes for the two that are not verbatim mirrors). The inbox has no evidence_remove key (its retire list is prose in notes) and writes no score, score_labor, tier or opening_line rows, so none were checked. Stated rows only: 1/15 = 6.7%. Retire list (notes) checked against evidence.csv: each named old row exists (weld_processes unknown for Corn Island, Valmont, Construction Attachments; Nucor weld_processes unknown job-posting row and inferred company-level SAW row; Nucor address inferred row; Corn Island materials unknown) and each is superseded by a stated row confirmed here, except Corn Island materials, superseded by the corrected row.
worst_errors: p-corn-island-grandview-in:materials - 'mild steel' rests on a grinding-wheel removal rating the permit attributes to the wheel manufacturer, not on a statement of what the yard works; corrected to 'steel' citing the permit's 0.5 in plate-steel cutting and steel-hull blasting lines. No score effect.
score_notes: No score rows in the inbox; the profiler says the coordinator re-scores. Process moves implied by the new stated rows, pending the coordinator ruling (process component only; all other components as in plants.csv today). Session-2 process rule: MIG or flux-core stated by the plant = 20; a permit naming the process at the address counts as stated by the plant (FWT precedent, 2026-11-17).

p-corn-island-grandview-in: process 0 -> 20 (95 FCAW stations, FCAW dominant) gives 30 -> 50, Low -> Medium, confidence 2 -> 3. RULING: 45 SMAW (stick) stations sit beside the FCAW; the CLAUDE.md rubric has no stick tier (20 MIG/flux-core, 12 mixed with TIG, 4 mostly TIG or spot), so 20 reads as written. Station counts are permit capacity (units constructed 1990). Material stays 0: steel is now stated but no part size (ships rule 2).
p-construction-attachments-lenoir-nc: process 0 -> 20 (ES-3 MIG welding operations, inspection 2026-07-02) gives 36 -> 56, Low -> Medium, confidence 2 -> 3.

p-nucor-crawfordsville-in: process 0 -> 20 (MCAW and FCAW alongside SAW in the pole building, August 2026 application; poles rule: MIG/flux-core stated in production = 20 even with SAW seams; FWT permit precedent, GMAW and SAW 0 -> 20) gives 45 -> 65, Medium, confidence 3 -> 4.

p-valmont-plymouth-in: process 0 -> 20 (47 MIG stations at Plant 1 as of 2023-03-27; 2025 6X report confirms welding stations still in use) gives 21 -> 41, Low, confidence 0 -> 1. Same-property campus: Plant 1 and Plant 2 are one IDEM source on one piece of property, so the fact counts for the ledger record.
opening_line_problems: p-nucor-crawfordsville-in:opening_line (not in this inbox) says 'your Crawfordsville plant'; the company's application places the plant at 4129 East Ladoga Road, New Ross, 'near Crawfordsville'. Nucor's own announcement wording may support Crawfordsville; coordinator to check wording when the city is ruled.
plant_status_notes: All four operating on the documents: Construction Attachments inspection 2026-07-02 'Operating'; Nucor application August 2026 (as-built); Valmont 6X report for 2025 (received 2026-01-23); Corn Island FESOP 2024-05-22 with VFC filings through 2026-07-30.
field_drift_notes: p-nucor-crawfordsville-in: the plants update sets address to 4129 East Ladoga Road, New Ross, IN 47968 but city stays Crawfordsville and lat/lon (40.0408627, -86.8997385) are a Crawfordsville point. City should become New Ross and the point re-geocoded; Census returns no match for the address (three spellings tried 2026-11-17), so a registry or approximate point is needed. Coordinator ruling (profiler flagged the same).

method: Fresh curl download of every cited document 2026-11-17 into a new scratch directory; pdftotext in layout and raw modes; each quote split on '...' and checked by script against whitespace-normalised text (15/15 found). IDEM VFC search API (xSourceID 107-00088, 099-00054, 147-00047) read for document dates; page 1 of the Nucor application rendered to read the received stamp, and the 9/9/2026 email copy (dID 84008702) opened. Census geocoder tried for the New Ross address. No web search used. No ledger file edited.
apply_note: Apply after the coordinator merges ledger/inbox/permits-2.json (rows keyed to that file's claim_id + source_url). One row changes: p-corn-island-grandview-in:materials (47106f.pdf) takes corrected_value, corrected_quote and tag stated; plants.csv materials takes plants_csv_value. Rule on the Nucor city/geocode and the Valmont address (field_drift_notes), and on the four implied process re-scores (score_notes; Corn Island SMAW is a RULING).
